title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Joshua 5: circumcision at Gilgal, the first Passover in the land, and the commander of Yahweh's army.

questions.text: What happened to the kings of the Amorites and the Canaanites when they heard Yahweh had dried up the Jordan?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says their heart melted, and there was no more spirit in them, because of the children of Israel.

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell Joshua to make?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says: "Make flint knives, and circumcise again the sons of Israel the second time."

questions.text: Where did Joshua circumcise the sons of Israel?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says Joshua circumcised the sons of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.

answers.text: At the hill of the foreskins

questions.text: Why were the people born in the wilderness uncircumcised?
questions.explanation: Verses 5 and 7 say those born in the wilderness had not been circumcised, because they had not circumcised them on the way.

answers.text: Moses had forbidden it in the wilderness
They had no knives to do it with
They had not circumcised them on the way
The priests had all died on the way

questions.text: How long did the children of Israel walk in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness until the men of war who came out of Egypt were consumed.

questions.text: What did Yahweh say he had rolled away from them?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says: "Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you." Therefore the place was called Gilgal.

questions.text: When did Israel keep the Passover in the plains of Jericho?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says they kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month at evening in the plains of Jericho.

answers.text: On the tenth day of the month in the morning
On the fourteenth day of the month at evening
On the first day of the month at noon
On the seventh day of the month at night

questions.explanation: Verse 12 says the manna ceased on the next day, after they had eaten of the produce of the land.

answers.text: It kept falling for another forty days
It turned to dust on the ground each morning
It ceased the day after they ate the produce of the land
It fell only on the Sabbath from then on

questions.text: What did the man who stood in front of Joshua near Jericho have in his hand?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says a man stood in front of him with his sword drawn in his hand.

questions.text: What did the prince of Yahweh's army tell Joshua to do?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says: "Take off your sandals, for the place on which you stand is holy." Joshua did so.
